summary: Tested Growth Agent autonomous SEO monitoring panel and Site Publishing Gateway. All core features working correctly. Backend tests pass (2/2). Frontend UI loads correctly with all Growth Agent elements visible. Google APIs return 403 SERVICE_DISABLED as expected (documented blocker). Internal tracking and sitemap generation work after gateway authorization.

minor.issue: Returns 400 when strategy not in autonomous mode - this is expected behavior, not a bug

critical_code_review_comments: Test file test_phase3_marketing.py had a bug where TestGrowthAgent test created a new company but didn't switch to it before calling authorize endpoint - FIXED by adding company switch and proper cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Growth Agent panel fully functional. Google APIs (GSC/GA4) return 403 SERVICE_DISABLED because they are not enabled in the Google project - this is expected and documented as a blocker in the UI. Internal tracking works after gateway authorization. Sitemap XML is populated with public pages after authorization. The run endpoint requires strategy to be in autonomous mode first.
